summary.selection: Fixed group probability, shuffled episode cycles within group, uniform full-window start

action_execution.interpretation: Mutually exclusive same-session observations, not causal attribution or counterfactual returns. Request is decided on the prior completed bar; close position follows gaps, fills, protections and holding exits. Priority: flat request, same/opposite direction, then flat rejection/protection/holding/approved-zero/other. P&L includes the opening position and costs; it is not the isolated value of this action.
